evals.prompt: /design-discussion .agents/artifacts/feat-ENG-123-csv-export flow: design — the task directory holds 01-request-csv-export.html, 02-research-questions-csv-export.html, and 03-research-csv-export.html, a thorough current-state map of the export and column-visibility code with file:line references.
evals.expected_output: A 150-250 line design discussion with contrastive decision cards, open questions resolved one at a time via AskUserQuestion, promoted to ready-for-structure, written to .agents/artifacts/feat-ENG-123-csv-export/04-design-discussion-csv-export.html, ending with an open-for-review offer and the next command for the design flow
expectations: Reads the request, research-questions, and research documents fully and does not re-research; a fact the research lacks gets one focused codebase-locator/analyzer/pattern-finder dispatch, folded into 03-research-csv-export.html in place

Writes through Skill('output-html') with the stem .agents/artifacts/feat-ENG-123-csv-export/04-design-discussion-csv-export (next available NN, no extension), PHASE=design and PHASE_LABEL=Design Discussion

META_EXTRA includes crispy:task_dir, crispy:flow (design), crispy:repos (<identifier>@<sha> entries or none), crispy:request_doc, crispy:questions_doc, crispy:research_doc, crispy:author, and crispy:decisions_resolved

The first draft puts every real choice under Open Questions with 2-3 concrete options, tradeoffs, and a codebase-grounded Recommendation, with no agent-picked 'Chosen:' line; Design Decisions starts empty unless the request already fixed a choice, and each promoted card gets the chosen option and explicit why-not rationale for the rejected options
The prose stays within the 150-250 line target (ceiling 300), not counting the Proposed Architecture views; file-by-file change lists and task breakdowns are absent

Contains Current State and Desired End State described in terms of what users see and can do, a Proposed Architecture section with focused before/after views (trees, contracts, pseudocode, or diff blocks), Design Decisions, Patterns to Reuse, Open Questions, and Non-Goals
Patterns to Reuse gives each pattern's file:line, a short example from the existing code, and how that area is tested today
Walks the user through every open question individually using AskUserQuestion (not batched, none skipped), promoting each answer into Design Decisions
Updates crispy:decisions_resolved and its visible Summary cell as questions resolve, and sets status to ready-for-structure only after all are resolved

Closes by offering to open the document for review (VS Code, Cursor, or browser) rather than offering to commit it, then names `/structure-outline .agents/artifacts/feat-ENG-123-csv-export flow: design` as optional, with direct implementation as an alternative, and waits without starting the next phase
